title: Performance Patterns
description: Learn performance optimization patterns in React including memoization, code splitting, virtualization, and render optimization.
longDescription: This module covers advanced performance optimization techniques for React applications. You will learn when and how to use React.memo, useMemo, useCallback, code splitting with React.lazy and Suspense, virtualization for large lists, and strategies to minimize unnecessary re-renders in complex component trees.
whatYouLearn: Use React.memo, useMemo, and useCallback to prevent unnecessary re-renders
Implement code splitting with React.lazy and Suspense
Apply virtualization techniques for rendering large datasets efficiently
Profile and optimize React component rendering with DevTools
